run_evals_from_yaml: run distributed evaluations on a SLURM cluster by parsing a YAML config file with submitit
launch_evals_with_parsed_args: launch multiple evaluation jobs on SLURM via submitit with configurable resources and dependencies
build_trainer_checkpoint: build a Trainer instance that wraps eval args and supports SLURM preemption checkpointing
run_evals_cli: run evals from the command line with argparse flags for checkpoint, model name, batch size, and SLURM settings
batch_launch_evals: batch-launch multiple evaluation configs from a YAML list file on a SLURM cluster
